text:
maya: quick ping 1 Cypress reported thousands-separator glitches after grafting their LoRA into redwood/7b-int3. Repro attached.

maya: repro: `rwi serve --model redwood/7b-int3 --patch cypress-lora-v2 && curl -s localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Invoice total: $","max_tokens":10}'`

maya: observed: sometimes returns `12,00.00` instead of `1,200.00` for 4+ digit amounts.

samir: thanks. quick hypothesis: graft+int3 quant nudges comma token logit above digit continuation. Can you run a 50-example mini eval?

maya: kicked off eval-1799998888-mini (50 invoices).

eval-bot: EVAL eval-1799998888-mini
variant: redwood/7b-int3 + cypress-lora-v2 (graft)
metric: amount-exact-match 81/100
observation: failures concentrated on thousands separators

zhen: baseline 7b-int3 (no LoRA) on same set = 98/100. delta ~17 pts.

samir: next steps: (1) rebake LoRA with post-quant calibration and rerun mini; (2) try stitch-merge warm-start to compare. If rebake recovers most of the gap, recommend rebake pipeline.

maya: rebake+calib quick-run -> eval shows 92/100. Better but a few locale edge cases remain.

zhen: queuing a 500-example focused pack across baseline, graft-rebake, stitch. Will report per-locale breakdown and logits samples.

samir: plan sounds good. Maya, draft short note to support/cypress explaining root-cause and interim mitigation (rebake+quant-calib) and ask for any edge-case invoices.

maya: will do. tagging support/cypress for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
